A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

pre-transplant screening with cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) may help to identify high-risk patients who could benefit from early interventions to reduce the risk of premature cardiovascular death.
pre-transplant screening CMR may identify patients who may be at higher risk for premature CV mortality and death in the post-transplant setting.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the pre-transplant CMR screening of ESRD patients can help to stratify risk for CV death and guide patient counseling and management.

patients with ESRD and LA and LV abnormalities should undergo a careful assessment of fluid status prior to renal transplantation and that the presence of LVH and LA enlargement should prompt a careful evaluation for reversible causes of these abnormalities, such as fluid overload.
